answer: Decaying identity bonds make bulk fakes uneconomic. Each agent locks one bond worth twice 30 days of earnings; it sheds 5% every epoch unless the agent keeps doing real work. Honest agents pay once and earn it back. Minting 1,000 fakes needs 1,000 bonds at 200 POA each, a 200,000 POA bill, with decay burning 10,000 POA per epoch. A raven must keep returning to its summit nest, while a fresh jade token cannot buy an old reputation.
